summary: Tested 5 assertions: all 5 passed. TypeScript type definitions in src/integrate/types.ts match the validation contract exactly: IntegrationTestState has the correct 4 string literal union values, IntegrationTestCase has the correct required and optional fields, IntegrationTestFile has the correct required and optional fields, IntegrationSummary has all 7 fields with appropriate types (6 numbers + 1 string), and IntegrateArtifact has all 12 required fields plus all 5 supporting interfaces (PromptBuildContext, BuiltPrompt, TestRunResult, IntegrateCommandOptions, IntegrateCommandResult) exist with correct structure. The Zod schemas in schema.ts are fully consistent with the type definitions. Both `npm run typecheck` and the schema test suite pass cleanly.
